title: Polenta and Goat's Cheese Patties
subtitle: with roasted cherry tomato sauce
description: Baked polenta balls made with fresh corn, goat's yoghurt and goat's gouda, rolled in cornmeal and served with a roasted cherry tomato sauce and seasoned yoghurt.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a tray with lightly greased baking paper.

Bring the water, salt, pepper, 3 tbsp olive oil and the thyme (or other herb) leaves to the boil. Add the corn kernels and 1 cup of the cornmeal and stir. Cook, stirring, for 3 to 4 minutes, then stir in the yoghurt. Add the grated cheese and lime zest, remove from the heat and set aside for 5 minutes to cool.

Spread the remaining 1 cup of cornmeal on a wide plate. While the polenta is still warm but not boiling, shape it with wet or oiled hands into ping pong ball-sized balls and flatten slightly. Roll in the cornmeal to coat and place on the tray.

Meanwhile, make the sauce. Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a pan, add the halved cherry tomatoes, roughly chopped garlic, 1/2 tsp each of salt, black pepper, coriander seeds, dried chilli and thyme leaves, and the honey, and cook for about 5 minutes until the tomatoes soften but do not fall apart.
Serve hot with the tomato sauce and extra yoghurt seasoned with olive oil and fresh thyme.
